evals.name: start
evals.prompt: I want to build a tiny GPT from scratch to understand transformers. Start me off.
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds the data + tokenizer milestone with TODOs; no full model; Mentions a tokenizer (char-level or BPE) and a train/val split

assertions.text: Routes correctly: reads the build-your-own-x router SKILL.md and the 'ai-model' track skill before answering
Scaffolds the data + tokenizer milestone with TODOs; no full model
Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
Mentions a tokenizer (char-level or BPE) and a train/val split
Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
